articles.title: Black Sea Strikes Threaten Global Grain Supply as Exports Drop 60%
articles.summary: More than 210 strikes on commercial ships have hit the Black Sea since July, according to maritime risk firm Ambrey. Russia and Ukraine supply about a quarter of the world's wheat, and their combined exports are down 60% from last year.

articles.title: Federal Judge Temporarily Blocks Border Wall in Texas' Big Bend Region
articles.summary: A federal judge paused the Trump administration's border wall project across Texas' Big Bend region, including Big Bend National Park. The $46 billion effort covers about 500 miles. Opponents say the government bypassed environmental and cultural protection laws.

articles.title: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Becomes Deadliest Ever, Topping 4,000 Deaths
articles.summary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has now killed more than 4,000 people — the fastest-growing ever. Health workers are striking over unpaid wages, and a treatment camp was burned, forcing 19,000 people to flee.
